ev.q: During 2010–2017, a total of 5,387 dengue cases were reported from U.S. states
The average annual incidence was 16 cases per 1 million U.S. travelers (range = 7–28).

methods_quotes.q: The incidence of dengue cases among U.S. outbound travelers was calculated using denominator data from the National Travel and Tourism Office.
Travelers to Europe were excluded from the denominator because of the small number of dengue cases reported from Europe.
Travel destinations were recorded as the areas visited outside the continental United States in the 14 days before illness onset
